sections.name: summary
sections.value:
Task detail for ph-7101. Each task row carries one done link to its own evidence list; task state is computed from that list, never typed.

Hand-authored as the JIT dogfood — this file is the fixture ph-7102's 5 tasks verb must reproduce. Section is named evidence under today's schema; the done_when rename is this phase's own deliverable (tk-7115).

value.title: dd read/write verb family: get / set / add / rm + CLI id minting
value.success: get returns values at any address kind; set/add/rm validate against the schema BEFORE writing and rebuild the sibling; add --mint <prefix> yields collision-free four-hex ids; surface manifest carries the four rows.
value.notes: FIRST TASK by Jordan's ruling — lands before everything else so the rest of this journey mutates dd through the CLI, never python. Born from the journey: DF-012 — agents were hand-editing .dd.json (dw-id collisions, stale siblings)

value.title: rel on link shapes: parse, allow-list, resolved-schema exposure
value.success: Declarations round-trip rel; unknown rel accepted as ref; pin in declarations.test.ts/parse.test.ts.

value.title: Frozen-five registry: manifest row + surface test
value.success: Manifest names the five rels; surface test counts them.

value.title: Links bucket: shape treatment + renderer final-column
value.success: Column appears only when populated; absent ⇒ byte-identical goldens.

value.title: Synthetic corpus factory + lifecycle-mutation suites
value.success: Factory builds mock plans/phases/task files; suites drive tick/untick/block/human-skip/JIT-birth/basis-drift mutations asserting validate + gate verdicts at each step; shared by ph-7102 and ph-7103 test suites.

tk-7111.assertion: Declarations round-trip a rel on single and array link shapes; resolved schema exposes it.
The parse-layer allow-list carries rel — pinned in declarations.test.ts/parse.test.ts, not the renderer suite.
An unknown rel string is accepted and behaves as ref.

tk-7112.assertion: The surface manifest names exactly the five built-in rels.
The surface test counts them and fails on any sixth.

tk-7113.assertion: A populated links bucket renders as a final Links column.
An absent bucket renders byte-identical to today (golden pin).

tk-7114.assertion: dd graph map labels edges with their rel.
--rel filters the walk to matching edges.

tk-7115.assertion: done_when rename lands in builder schemas; dw- ids unchanged.
satisfies declared always-array; a non-array fails validation (planted-bad).
An assertion without pressure is a validation ERROR (planted-bad); not-applicable validates and renders.
Every existing builder/* link field declares its rel — schema test pins the map.

tk-7121.assertion: Each rel path (proven_by/satisfies/derives) has a planted-bad fixture that FIRES.
Consistent-open and evidence-ready-unclaimed cells stay silent (good twins).

tk-7122.assertion: Mid-flight run emits one info summary line and zero per-row warnings.

tk-7123.assertion: --complete green means exactly 0 errors and 0 warnings.
An orphan AC (no incoming satisfies) warns under --complete (planted fixture).

tk-7124.assertion: A phase-scoped run excludes other phases' open items.
An AC-scoped run shows the full proof tree including incoming satisfies.

tk-7125.assertion: E450-E459 allocated with JSDoc discipline; manifest row added.
dd-surface.test.ts green with the adjusted code count.

tk-7126.assertion: dd validate behaviour byte-identical on existing corpora (regression pin).

tk-7127.assertion: The factory builds mock plans/phases/task files on demand.
Mutation suites cover tick/untick/block/human-skip/JIT-birth/basis-drift with validator+gate verdicts asserted at each step.

tk-7128.assertion: dd get resolves section, instance, and part addresses and returns the value (json + human).
A set/add violating the schema is refused with the validation issue and writes NOTHING.
Every successful mutation rebuilds the .dd.md sibling in the same operation.
add --mint produces the next collision-free id under the registered prefix (the DF-008 bug class is unrepresentable).
The dd surface manifest names get/set/add/rm; the surface test counts them.
